summary: In files/, add ansible.cfg with a galaxy server_list pointing to the private automation hub, pip.conf with index-url for an internal PyPI mirror, and optionally custom.repo pointing at mirrored UBI or Satellite RPM repositories.
questions: How do I use an internal PyPI mirror with ansible-builder?
ansible.cfg for private automation hub in an execution environment build
How do I add custom RPM repos to an execution environment?

answer_card.title: Offline build config files
answer_card.answer_md:
`files/ansible.cfg`:
```ini
[galaxy]
server_list = private_hub

[galaxy_server.private_hub]
url = https://private-hub.example.com/api/galaxy/
```
`files/pip.conf`:
```ini
[global]
index-url = https://<pypi_mirror_fqdn>/
trusted-host = <pypi_mirror_fqdn>
```
Optional `files/custom.repo` points at your mirrored UBI or Satellite repos.
